tools.name: search_interior_answers
tools.description: Search ABIS public interior planning answers for room layout, kitchen storage, bedroom styling, lighting, bathroom renovation cost factors and consultation preparation. Returns grounded summaries and citation URLs. Does not search customer accounts or photos.

tools.name: get_interior_answer
tools.description: Read an ABIS public interior answer by the slug returned from search_interior_answers. Returns practical planning guidance, a checklist and source links for the host AI to explain. These are general planning references, not a structural assessment or fixed quote.

tools.name: get_interior_styles
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to redesign their room from a photo, see a different interior style in their own home, prepare a floor-plan concept or a materials/lighting proposal, or compare ABIS styles. Returns a direct ABIS photo-upload link with optional room/style choices preserved, plus the phot

tools.name: get_consultation_options
tools.description: Get the verified profile and contact options of Dongbang Interior (동방인테리어), a home interior and remodeling contractor in Gwangjin-gu, Seoul serving Seoul, Gyeonggi and Incheon. Use it when the user looks for or compares an interior contractor in the Seoul metropolitan area, or asks for human consult

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_interior_answers · Private data: get_consultation_options · Public sink: get_interior_styles, get_consultation_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_interior_answers · Private data: get_consultation_options · Public sink: get_interior_styles, get_consultation_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_interior_styles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List Dongbang Interior photo design styles and supported room categories, with a link to the separate photo-design website. Daily image limits apply on the website. Style references are illustrative. This public tool does not upload photos, generate paid images or expose a personal workspace." → after: "Use this when the user wants to redesign their room from a photo, see a different interior style in their own home, prepare a floor-plan concept or a materials/lighting proposal, or compare ABIS styles. Returns a direct ABIS photo-upload link with optional room/style choices preserved, plus the phot"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
